defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Its approach treats shortest-path distances between centerpiece canvases as sufficient and fails to account correctly for sharing intermediate Steiner vertices across multiple terminal connections.

Its metric-closure/MST-style reasoning does not preserve the savings obtainable from one shared non-centerpiece connector, so it can return a terminal-only connection cost instead of the minimum Steiner-tree cost.

recommended_edit: No edit can defeat both surviving exact solutions without changing the computational task. Restricting mandates to pairs of centerpiece canvases would defeat them, but would also change the problem and invalidate Example 1.
